Here’s a detailed, up-to-date research note on the claim that “a mathematician claims AI helped solve the Riemann Hypothesis.”

---

## What is being claimed

- On **November 20, 2026**, Levent Alpöge, a number theorist working with AI company **Anthropic**, published a **four-page note** on his personal website stating: “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.” ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  
- The same note also claims the method extends to the **Generalized Riemann Hypothesis (GRH)**. ([ibm.com](https://www.ibm.com/think/news/anthropic-claude-riemann-hypothesis-math-proof?utm_source=openai))  
- Alpöge posted **Lean formal-proof files** (theorem-prover code) supporting the claim. He notes that an earlier draft ran “past 250,000 pages,” but released only the Lean version and the shorter note for public visibility. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What is *not* yet established or verified

- **No completed peer-reviewed publication** of a conventional mathematical paper has appeared. The 250,000-page write-up remains unpublished. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  
- **Independent verification** is pending. Mathematicians have begun examining the Lean files and the arguments, but as of the latest reports, **no external expert has yet confirmed** that the proof is correct. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  
- The **Clay Mathematics Institute**, which awards the $1 million Millennium Prize for a valid proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, still lists the problem as unsolved. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Why the announcement is partial/qualified

- The claim is described by Alpöge in terms of belief: *“I believe … I have … discovered a proof…”* rather than a definitive statement. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  
- Alpöge himself acknowledges the proof currently exists primarily as **formal code** in Lean and that the human-readable exposition (if produced) is extremely large and difficult to parse. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  
- Multiple prominent mathematicians have expressed caution. While some are optimistic, none has publicly confirmed correctness. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Context & timeline

- This announcement coincided with **Anthropic’s IPO**, which valued the company at about **US$1.5 trillion**. Some reporting notes that Alpöge contacted Anthropic leadership before the announcement. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  
- The Riemann Hypothesis, first put forward by Bernhard Riemann in 1859, has for over a century been one of the most famous unsolved problems in mathematics, and is one of seven **Millennium Prize Problems** each with a US$1 million reward if a valid proof is submitted and accepted. ([amp.dw.com](https://amp.dw.com/en/anthropic-researcher-uses-ai-to-solve-maths-greatest-riddle/a-80008428?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Independent & primary source evidence

- **Primary source**: Alpöge’s note (four pages) on his personal website, plus a Lean formalization of the claimed proof. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  
- **Independent sources**: 
  - Nature published a news article summarizing the claim and its status. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai))  
  - Associated Press (via ABC News et al.) reported the announcement, including quotes, and highlighted lack of verification. ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai))  
  - Washington Post, New Scientist, DW, Scientific American, and others have articles describing the claim in similar terms. ([washingtonpost.com](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/11/20/using-anthropic-ai-mathematician-claims-have-solved-riemann-hypothesis/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## How close is this to being a completed outcome?

- At this moment (as of **November 20-21, 2026**) the claim is **not yet a validated or accepted proof**. It is a **public claim**, supported by formal code, awaiting full peer review and mathematical consensus.  
- Verification could take **weeks or longer** (some sources suggest). ([1-e8259.azureedge.net](https://1-e8259.azureedge.net/news/2026/11/21/riemann-hypothesis-has-the-worlds-most-famous-maths-problem-been-cracked?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Summary with what is known vs not known

| Status                   | Confirmed/Documented                                         | Unverified/Claimed                                                |
|---------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Claim made**            | Levent Alpöge claims to have found a proof using Claude.      ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03812-7?utm_source=openai)) | That claim is correct (proof is valid)                             |
| **Proof form**            | Code in Lean, formalization exists.                          ([turkiyetoday.com](https://www.turkiyetoday.com/lifestyle/turkish-mathematician-claims-ai-helped-solve-167-year-old-riemann-hypothesis-3232905?utm_source=openai)) | A readable conventional paper with proof exposition published      |
| **Extension to GRH**      | Alpöge's note claims the method extends to Generalized RH.   ([ibm.com](https://www.ibm.com/think/news/anthropic-claude-riemann-hypothesis-math-proof?utm_source=openai)) | That extension is verified                                           |
| **Prize award / acceptance** | The problem is still listed as unsolved by Clay Institute.  ([abcnews.com](https://abcnews.com/Technology/wireStory/anthropic-worker-claims-solved-holy-grail-math-problems-138338426?utm_source=openai)) | Prize awarded or proof accepted                                       |

---

## Conclusion

- The report that “AI helped solve the Riemann Hypothesis” refers to a **claim** by a mathematician working with an AI tool, supported by formal code, but **not yet independently verified**.  
- It is **not yet a confirmed or completed outcome** in the sense that the mathematics community has accepted the proof.  
- Given the magnitude of the claim, verification (by checking the formal code, by producing an understandable exposition, etc.) is necessary before it can be considered resolved.

---

stories.research_notes:
Here’s a factual research note on the event “Conservation Efforts for Unique Landscapes in Galicia”, focusing on the protection and management of the *Penedos de Pasarela e Traba*. This checks the sources, what has actually been done/completed, what remains planned, and what measurable outcomes exist.

---

## Key Facts & Legal/Institutional Background

- **Protected status**: The *Penedos de Pasarela e Traba* (“Pasarela and Traba Rocks”) are officially designated as a *paisaje protegido* (protected landscape) in Galicia. This was established by **Decreto 294/2008**, of 11 December 2008. ([medioambiente.xunta.gal](https://medioambiente.xunta.gal/seccion-organizacion/c/CMAOT_DX_Conservacion_Natureza?content=Direccion_Xeral_Conservacion_Natureza%2FEspazos_protexidos%2FRede_galega%2FPaisaxe_protexida%2Fseccion.html&std=Penedos_de_P_e_T.html&utm_source=openai))  
- **Size & location**: The protected area spans approximately **212 hectares**, shared between the municipalities of Vimianzo (about 109 ha) and Laxe (about 103 ha), in the province of A Coruña. ([noticias.juridicas.com](https://noticias.juridicas.com/base_datos/CCAA/937388-d-186-2024-de-14-oct-ca-galicia-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje-protegido-de.html?utm_source=openai))  
- **Governing law for planning**: Under **Ley 5/2019, de 2 de agosto**, Galicia requires all protected landscapes to have a *Plan de Gestión* (management plan) that defines permissible uses, conservation rules, and species/habitat protection. ([noticias.juridicas.com](https://noticias.juridicas.com/base_datos/CCAA/937388-d-186-2024-de-14-oct-ca-galicia-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje-protegido-de.html?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What Was Announced / Launched

- **Approval of a Plan de Gestión**: On **14 October 2024**, Galicia’s Xunta approved *Decreto 186/2024*, setting the first formal management plan for the Penedos de Pasarela e Traba. It was published in the *Diario Oficial de Galicia* on **13 November 2024**, and came into effect **20 days** later. ([gaia.xunta.gal](https://gaia.xunta.gal/es/legislacion/decreto-1862024-de-14-de-octubre-por-el-que-se-aprueba-el-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje?utm_source=openai))  
- **Budget allocation**: The Xunta committed **€600,000** for signage, ordering (regulation/layout), and promotional activities for the area. ([g24.gal](https://www.g24.gal/-/a-xunta-impulsa-un-plan-para-coidar-e-potenciar-os-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba?utm_source=openai))  
- **Regulation of activities**: The plan includes rules for public use and sports, including:
  - **Escalada** (rock climbing): allowed in certain zones, prohibited in others, especially sensitive cultural heritage places. Specified rules about calibration of equipment (e.g. no fixed anchors, no marking rocks, removal of chalk if used) and not disturbing vegetation. ([montanaregulada.org](https://montanaregulada.org/area/penedos-de-traba-y-pasarela?utm_source=openai))  
  - Use of trails, connection roads, public access points; restoration or maintenance of existing paths and roads (e.g. the track “Traba – Cruce do Brañal – O Penedo”). ([noticias.juridicas.com](https://noticias.juridicas.com/base_datos/CCAA/937388-d-186-2024-de-14-oct-ca-galicia-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje-protegido-de.html?utm_source=openai))  

- **Other planned actions** include: studies of climate change impacts; installation of informational panels; guided tours with geologists; maintaining and defining the values of the landscape and associated flora. ([diariodesantiago.es](https://www.diariodesantiago.es/galicia/rueda-presenta-el-plan-de-gestion-de-los-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Measured, Completed Outcomes & Status

- **Completed legal regulation**: The management plan is **approved and in force** (since early December 2024, as the 20-day delay after DOG publication). Thus the legal framework for conservation is established. ([noticias.juridicas.com](https://noticias.juridicas.com/base_datos/CCAA/937388-d-186-2024-de-14-oct-ca-galicia-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje-protegido-de.html?utm_source=openai))  
- **Concrete rights and restrictions**: Activities such as rock climbing have specific rules already active under the plan—some sectors now require authorization, some are prohibited. These are measurable restrictions. ([montanaregulada.org](https://montanaregulada.org/area/penedos-de-traba-y-pasarela?utm_source=openai))  
- **Funds allocated**: The budget (≈ €600,000) has been assigned for certain projects (signage, promotion, ordering), but as of the latest sources, these seem *budgeted/planned*, not necessarily fully executed. ([g24.gal](https://www.g24.gal/-/a-xunta-impulsa-un-plan-para-coidar-e-potenciar-os-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What Remains Planned, Uncertain, or Under Implementation

- **Implementation of planned works**: Signage, promotional activities, guided tours, public information panels—these are part of the plan but no credible sources show full completion of these as of now. They are **announced**, but not necessarily executed. ([g24.gal](https://www.g24.gal/-/a-xunta-impulsa-un-plan-para-coidar-e-potenciar-os-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba?utm_source=openai))  
- **Monitoring & studies**: Research on climate change and its effects has been proposed. There is no published result yet in the sources found. ([diariodesantiago.es](https://www.diariodesantiago.es/galicia/rueda-presenta-el-plan-de-gestion-de-los-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Enforcement and oversight**: Rules and prohibitions exist, but their effectiveness (e.g. compliance, reductions in damage or illicit activity) aren't reported yet. ([montanaregulada.org](https://montanaregulada.org/area/penedos-de-traba-y-pasarela?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Independent Reporting & Sources

- **Xunta official documents**: The *Decreto 186/2024* and the DOG publication are primary, legal and administrative sources. ([gaia.xunta.gal](https://gaia.xunta.gal/es/legislacion/decreto-1862024-de-14-de-octubre-por-el-que-se-aprueba-el-plan-de-gestion-del-paisaje?utm_source=openai))  
- **News media verification**:
  - **Diario de Santiago**: Reports on Rueda (president of Xunta) presenting the plan for protection and promotion, confirming legal approval and key features. ([diariodesantiago.es](https://www.diariodesantiago.es/galicia/rueda-presenta-el-plan-de-gestion-de-los-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba/?utm_source=openai))  
  - **G24.gal**: Gives budget figure (€600,000) and confirms the plan is being acted upon to "coidarlo e potencíalo" (take care of and enhance it). ([g24.gal](https://www.g24.gal/-/a-xunta-impulsa-un-plan-para-coidar-e-potenciar-os-penedos-de-pasarela-e-traba?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Summary: What Actually Happened by Nov 2026

- The Penedos de Pasarela e Traba are legally protected since **2008**, under Galician and Spanish environmental law.  
- A fully articulated **management plan** (Plan de gestión) was approved by decree in **October 2024**, published in official sources in **November 2024**, and came into force roughly **early December 2024**.  
- The plan defines permitted and prohibited uses, especially regulating recreational activities like climbing, controlling access and public use, with the goal of conserving geological, ecological, and landscape values.  
- There’s a budget (~€600,000) earmarked for conservation infrastructure (paths, signage) and promotion, plus commitment to environmental studies and public outreach.  
- As of latest sources up through 2025 and early 2026, outcomes beyond legal adoption (such as construction of signage, guided tours, full enforcement) are **in progress or planned**, not reported to be fully realized.

---

If you like, I can check whether there has since (in 2025-2026) been reporting on measurable ecological or environmental improvements (e.g. reduced erosion, visitor management, species protection) to assess environmental impact properly.
